drawings.description: schéma suivant, entre deux traits horizontaux et en partie entouré : $G(C)$ envoie une flèche vers $\prod G(\mathcal{O}_x)$ et une vers $G(K)$ ; ces deux groupes s'envoient sur $R^{0}_G$ ; de $R^{0}_G$ partent une flèche vers $J^{0}_G$ et une vers $\mathcal{D}iv^{0}_G$, qui aboutissent toutes deux, par des traits, à $H^1(X, G)^{0}$
drawings.kind: arrow diagram between two horizontal lines, partly enclosed
drawings.notes: G(C) -> prod G(O_x) and G(K); both -> R^0_G; R^0_G -> J^0_G and Div^0_G; both joined by strokes to H^1(X, G)^0. The two horizontal lines and the pencil strokes partly enclosing the left part are drawn; the small crosses on the arrows out of G(C) are left out.

drawings.description: croquis en marge gauche ; une flèche en pointillé monte vers $Q$, un trait relie $Q$ à la ligne du bas
drawings.kind: margin sketch: dotted arrow up to Q, stroke from Q down
drawings.notes: A dotted arrow rising to Q, and a stroke from Q down towards the line X - S below. Q' and Q'' around it are text of the page; the strokes higher in the margin belong to the margin note.

drawings.description: à gauche, des croquis de segments subdivisés, avec les légendes :
drawings.notes: Two horizontal segments: the first with heavy end ticks, a small tick and a crossed point marked with a small v above; the second with heavy ticks near both ends and a small tick beyond. The legends are text after the mark.

drawings.description: à droite, des croquis de segments subdivisés, légendés $\Delta^n$, $\Delta^{n+1}$, $\Delta^{n+2}$ et « $x_0\ x_1\ x_2 - x_n$ »
drawings.notes: Several graduated segments, some intervals thickened: one under d' +- d'', two pairs labelled Delta^n, Delta^{n+1}, Delta^{n+2}, and a last row with x_0 x_1 x_2 - x_n. The "(d) Calcul d_i" and the small labels on the left are text.

drawings.description: à droite, un croquis : un segment de $a$ à $b$, coupé entre $\alpha$ et $\beta$ par un trait oblique légendé « \uncertain{fenêtre} » ; dessous :
drawings.kind: segment a..b cut by an oblique stroke
drawings.notes: A segment from a to b, heavy from a to alpha, then from beta to b with a point and a tick; an oblique stroke cuts it between alpha and beta, labelled "fenetre" (uncertain reading kept).

drawings.description: sous les chaînes, deux croquis de segments gradués parcourus par des flèches vers la gauche, un petit parallélogramme marqué d'un point, et un « $A$ » isolé
drawings.kind: graduated segments with leftward arrows; small parallelogram with a point; isolated A
drawings.notes: Top right: a segment between two points with a curved arrow running to the left; lower, a row of leftward arrows under [phi_0 -> ... -> phi_n] (the second sketch, read as such); bottom left a small parallelogram with a point inside; an isolated A. Which strokes the transcription counts as the second graduated segment is a reading.

drawings.description: à gauche, un croquis de parallélogramme ; à droite, deux segments gradués, dont l'un a un intervalle épaissi
drawings.notes: Left: a tall parallelogram (a mark at a top corner and one at a lower corner); a second, flatter parallelogram higher up at the left is also drawn. Right: two graduated segments, the first with ticks and a thickened interval, the second drawn double. Not covered by the mark: a small sketch of arrows in the lower middle and a graduated segment with arrows at the lower right.

drawings.description: au centre, un croquis : deux cercles sécants et un point
drawings.kind: two intersecting circles and a point
drawings.notes: Two intersecting circles (the lower one larger) and a point, with a short stroke through it (it looks like a phi written in the circles).

drawings.description: à droite, deux croquis : un secteur coupé de deux arcs, et une figure portant « $X_{1} \neq \emptyset$ », « $X = \emptyset$ » et une accolade marquée $\alpha_{p}$ (?). Au bas, raturé et entrelacé de traits, un reste de suite « $\ldots \to W \to W/N \to \ldots$ », et en marge droite, écrit en long, « \uncertain{cf.} \ill{} V.A.\ \ill{} Lang ».
drawings.kind: sector cut by two arcs; figure with X_1 != empty, X = empty
drawings.notes: Two sketches at the left of the page among struck lines: a sector cut by two arcs (crossed by a stroke), and an outlined figure with a pointed corner, labels X = empty / emptyset != X near it (as read; the subscript 1 and the brace alpha_p of the transcription are not found and are left out). The long oblique line crossing the page and the struck sequence at the bottom are not drawn.
drawings.disagreement: The transcription places these sketches "a droite"; on the render they are at the left of p. 107 (the only figure at the right is a narrow upright ellipse at the top).

drawings.description: schéma encadré : à gauche $\mathbb{G}_m$, $\mathbb{G}_a$ soulignés ; deux traits en éventail en partent. Sur le trait supérieur : $\mathbb{Z}/\ell\mathbb{Z}$, puis $\mu_p$, $\alpha_p$, $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ ; sur le trait inférieur : $\mu_p$, $\alpha_p$, $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$, puis $\mathbb{Z}/\ell\mathbb{Z}$ ; les deux convergent vers $\mathbb{V}$ et $\mathbb{Z}$ (lettres doublées) soulignés, à droite. Le schéma met face à face, dans l'ordre inverse, les groupes que la page 192 énumère
drawings.kind: framed schema: two fans of groups from G_m, G_a to V, Z
drawings.notes: In a frame: G_m, G_a underlined at the left; two strokes fanning out; on the upper stroke Z/lZ, then mu_p, alpha_p, Z/pZ; on the lower stroke mu_p, alpha_p, Z/pZ, then Z/lZ; both converge to V and Z (doubled letters) underlined at the right. Two long strokes crossing the frame (crossing out the page) are drawn grey.
